description: A 2HP window comparator in one section, giving gates for inside, outside, above and below a range set by two knobs

params.text: Sets the bottom of the range, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, and -5V unless you move it
Counts a voltage exactly equal to the bottom of the range as inside it while this is on
Sets the top of the range, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, and +5V unless you move it
Counts a voltage exactly equal to the top of the range as inside it while this is on
Chooses what the last two outputs carry: gates for above and below the range, or the difference between the input and each end of it

inputs.text: The voltage being tested against the range
Adds its voltage to the Min knob
Adds its voltage to the Max knob

outputs.text: Carries a high gate while the input is inside the range
Carries a high gate while the input is outside the range, and stays high whenever Min is above Max in the default Min/Max mode
Carries a high gate while the input is above the top of the range, or in Diff mode the input minus the top of the range
Carries a high gate while the input is below the bottom of the range, or in Diff mode the input minus the bottom of the range

notes: setting Min above Max is an error state in the default mode: the light beside Min turns red and the !Rng output is held high; Auto-swap on the menu swaps the two instead
menu: Min-mode: Min/Max, Auto-swap — chooses whether Min above Max is an error or is silently swapped
Diff-mode: Signed, Absolute — chooses whether the two difference outputs keep the sign or report a positive number
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
